title: Specification Confirmation and Production for Made-to-Order Reservations — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Atelier Note
content:
**Rule.** A Made-to-Order Reservation of Pre-Orders & Back-Orders goes into production only after the customer personally confirms the size and personalisation. The agent can explain and record the request but cannot confirm on the customer's behalf.

Specifications are confirmed only if the customer confirms them no later than the type's confirmation window in calendar days after the reservation is made. The reservation date is day zero, and the last day of the window still counts. Specifications are confirmed only while the reservation is in status reserved.

Without a timely confirmation, the reservation is cancelled for the reason specifications not confirmed and the deposit is refunded. Confirmed specifications cannot be changed. Production takes the type's production lead time in calendar days from its start.

**The confirmation window, worked (hypothetical reservation; Made-to-Order window of 7 days)**

| Day | Date | Confirmation by the customer |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 3 June (reservation date) | Counts |
| 7 | 10 June | Counts: last day of the window |
| 8 | 11 June | Does not count |

The window starts from the reservation date on the reservation record. The date compared is the calendar day on which the customer confirms.

**Conditions for a confirmation to stand**

| Customer confirms personally | Within the window | Reservation in status reserved | Specifications confirmed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | — | No |
| Yes | — | No | No |
| No (agent alone) | — | — | No |

**After confirmation.** The size and personalisation recorded at confirmation are final. Production then runs for the lead time, 42 calendar days for the Made-to-Order Reservation.
